title: spec review: P2 + P3/P4 (library): canonical evidence objects and a deterministic context router (HIDE/SHORT/LONG/FULL) with role profiles, pure functions, no packet wiring
spec:
Program brief .orchestrator/roadmap-context.md P2, P3, P4, P6, P7 (cache key only). This task builds the library; T-<wiring task> (filed separately, depends on this) hooks it into spawn packets in shadow. No existing behaviour changes.

A. orchestrator/evidence.py (new)
- `@dataclass(frozen=True) Evidence`: id (str, 12-hex sha256 over f"{source_type}|{location}|{content_hash}"), source_type (one of SOURCE_TYPES = ("source_chunk", "test_result", "scout_finding", "memory_entry", "graph_finding", "previous_result", "review_finding", "architecture_note", "decision", "external_doc")), location (str: path[:line-range], task id, memory heading), commit (str, goal head sha or ""), content_hash (sha256 of the raw content, full hex), content (str, raw, bounded by the caller), summary_short (str ≤ 160 chars: deterministic first meaningful line / signature / heading), summary_long (str ≤ 600 chars: first 600 chars of content with whitespace collapsed; callers may pass a better one), relevance (dict: scope_match bool, title_terms int (count of task-title words ≥4 chars found in content, case-insensitive), path_terms int (scope path stems found), recent_task str|None), provenance (one of "repo", "bus", "memory", "scout", "external"), observed_at (float epoch), trust ("trusted" for provenance repo/memory, "untrusted" otherwise).
- `make(source_type, location, content, *, commit="", provenance, task=None, scope=(), summary_long=None, observed_at=None) -> Evidence` computes id, hashes, summaries and relevance from task title/scope when task is given.
- `Pool` bound to a goal: file `.orchestrator/evidence/<goal>.jsonl` under STATE (create dir), `add(ev)` idempotent by id (returns existing), `get(id)`, `by_type(t)`, `fresh(ev, head_sha)` (True when ev.commit == head_sha or source_type not in ("source_chunk","test_result")), `stale_ids(head_sha)`. Never store secrets: run jev.redact over content before persisting and note it in the docstring.
- `cache_key(ev, task_class, role, level)` = sha256 of f"{ev.content_hash}|{task_class}|{role}|{level}"[:16] (P7 key shape; no summariser yet).

B. orchestrator/context_router.py (new)
- LEVELS = ("HIDE", "SHORT", "LONG", "FULL"); `@dataclass Routed`: evidence_id, level, reason (short deterministic string, e.g. "in_scope_file", "acceptance", "failing_output", "unrelated_memory", "stale", "read_scope", "dependency", "ambiguous"), tokens_full, tokens_at_level (chars//4 of the text render() would emit).
- `route(task, candidates: list[Evidence], *, role, head_sha=None, cfg=None) -> RoutedPacket` with RoutedPacket fields: items (list[Routed]), candidate_tokens, routed_tokens, reduction_ratio (routed/candidate, 1.0 when candidate 0), ambiguous_ids (list), profile (role name), rules_version ("v1").
- Deterministic rules (P4), applied in this order, first match wins: FULL when source_type=="source_chunk" and location's path is in task scope (write scope) and role in ("execute", "scout"); FULL for source_type "test_result" whose location matches a failing id in task.constraints/pipeline (fix rounds) or whose content contains "FAIL"/"ERROR"; FULL for the task's own spec/acceptance (source_type "architecture_note" with location "task:<id>:spec|acceptance", callers create these); HIDE when relevance.scope_match is False and title_terms == 0 and path_terms == 0 and source_type in ("memory_entry", "decision", "previous_result", "review_finding"); HIDE when not fresh(ev, head_sha) and source_type in ("source_chunk", "test_result"); SHORT for source_chunk not in scope (read scope / imports) in every role; LONG for previous_result, scout_finding, decision, memory_entry that match by scope or title terms; everything else → LONG with reason "ambiguous" and the id appended to ambiguous_ids (P5 hands these to Jev later; never call Jev here).
- Role profiles (P6): execute as above; review: source_chunk in scope → LONG (interface summary) not FULL, review_finding/previous_result → SHORT, test_result → FULL; security_review: like review plus FULL for any source_chunk whose path matches a [review] security_paths glob from cfg; planner: every source_chunk → SHORT, decisions/architecture_note → LONG; scout: FULL only for source_chunk in scope, else SHORT. Unknown role → execute profile.
- `render(routed_packet, pool_or_lookup) -> str`: "## evidence (routed v1)" followed by one block per non-HIDE item: SHORT = "- {location} — {summary_short}", LONG = "- {location}\n  {summary_long}", FULL = "- {location}\n```\n{content}\n```"; HIDE items are counted in a trailing line "hidden: N". Deterministic ordering: FULL, LONG, SHORT, then by location.
- `decision_row(task, routed_packet, *, mode)` returns the dict for decision_log.record(kind="context_selection", ...) with candidates = [id:level], hard_constraints = the FULL reasons, deterministic = {counts per level, candidate_tokens, routed_tokens, reduction_ratio, ambiguous: n}, selected = "routed v1", reason = f"{role} profile rules v1", mode = mode; no chain-of-thought text, no content. (Uses decision_log kind context_selection from T-0772.)

C. Tests (unittest, `import _harness` first): tests/test_evidence.py::test_make_ids_are_content_addressed_and_redacted, ::test_pool_add_is_idempotent_and_fresh_by_commit; tests/test_context_router.py::test_execute_profile_full_for_scope_hide_unrelated_memory, ::test_review_profile_long_for_scope_and_full_tests, ::test_render_orders_and_counts_hidden, ::test_reduction_ratio_and_ambiguous_bucket, ::test_decision_row_has_no_content. Fixtures build Evidence via make(); no real repo needed.
D. docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md (≤80 lines): the rule table per role, the Evidence schema, what shadow will log (from the wiring task), what is explicitly not done yet (Jev P5, summariser P7, active mode P21).
Constraints: no new dependencies; never call Jev; never read files outside STATE in this module (callers build Evidence). Do not ask questions; decide and note decisions in the result.
acceptance: docs/context-economy/05-context-router.md exists; no change to any existing module; .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh exits 0

risks.issue: Spec cites this file as the P2/P3/P4/P6/P7 program brief but it does not exist anywhere in the repo (checked via find and git log for T-0765/T-0772/T-0779). The repo's actual context-economy doc set (docs/context-economy/00-audit.md, 02-modes.md) uses a different numbering scheme (P26, P30, P27/P28), not P2/P3/P4/P6/P7. The doc deliverable (05-context-router.md) is asked to describe 'what shadow will log' and 'what's not done yet' with no real source to draw from, and the executor has no way to verify the cited P-numbers align with anything.

'no change to any existing module' is listed as an acceptance criterion but .claude/hooks/tests-green.sh only runs the test suite (confirmed by reading the hook) and no scope/diff enforcement exists in daemon.py or merge.py. This criterion cannot be verified by the stated gate; only a human diff review would catch a violation.

The spec names the new per-goal cache class 'Pool', but orchestrator/pool.py:145 already defines a class Pool (the account pool). Two same-named, semantically unrelated classes in the same package (orchestrator.pool.Pool vs orchestrator.evidence.Pool) is a naming collision a reviewer would reject — confusing in imports, greps, and any code that does 'from orchestrator import pool, evidence' and calls .Pool().

decision_row(task, routed_packet, *, mode) is specified to return 'the dict for decision_log.record(kind="context_selection", ...)', but decision_log.record(kind, subject, *, candidates, hard_constraints, deterministic, selected, reason, ...) requires a positional 'subject' that decision_row's field list never mentions producing. Ambiguous whether decision_row includes subject/kind keys or the wiring caller supplies them separately.

suggested_spec_changes: Either check in .orchestrator/roadmap-context.md with the P2/P3/P4/P6/P7 sections it cites (reconciled with existing P26/P30 numbering in docs/context-economy/00-audit.md), or drop the citation and let section A/B's inline rules stand as the sole source of truth for the executor and for 05-context-router.md.

Drop 'no change to any existing module' from acceptance, or replace it with a mechanically checkable form (e.g. 'git diff --stat main...HEAD touches only the scope list') that the Planner or a hook actually runs before merge.
Rename evidence.py's cache class to EvidencePool (or similar) to avoid colliding with orchestrator.pool.Pool.

State explicitly whether decision_row's returned dict is meant to be splatted directly into decision_log.record(subject=task.id, **decision_row(...)) or whether the wiring task assembles kind/subject itself.
